SMTO-RST-0010 — This task's saved Agent history can't be found

GUID: 98e90e3c-0b4d-4cd3-a160-8aa31d0902f9
Slug: resume-transcript-unavailable
Domain: RST · Subsystem: rst

What happened

  • You asked SMTO to continue a saved task, but it has no saved Agent history to pick up from, so it can't tell where the task stopped. Nothing new was run.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the old task's conversation and read its last results to see what finished. Without its saved history SMTO can't tell where the task stopped, so you need to check.
  2. If the task worked on things outside SMTO, such as files or other systems, check them directly. Check whether the earlier action already happened, so it isn't done twice.
  3. Send a new message describing only what's still left to do. A new message starts its own history and looks at things as they are now.

What success looks like

  • The new message runs and doesn't redo work that already finished.

If it still fails

  • Check whether the earlier action already happened before you try anything again. Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; the saved history may need to be recovered. Keep the old conversation; don't delete it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A resume required the run's saved native Agent transcript (native_resume_required), but initialization found no saved native state for that run.

What this means

  • native_resume_required is set but initialization finds no saved authoritative native state. State diagnostics preserve authoritative journal, ownership and effect evidence. They do not delete records, loosen ownership fences, issue SQL or restart/replay work; missing persistence confirmation is separate from in-memory acceptance.

Why this can happen

  • native_resume_required is set but initialization finds no saved authoritative native state.

How to diagnose it

  • Verify the original run identity and retained state rather than replaying an old plan.

How to fix it

  • No direct repair is available for this occurrence. Use the supported investigation or alternative workflow below.
  • native_resume_required was set but _initialize_owned found no saved native state. Preserve the historical record and inspect current external state in a new task before requesting further work; an old plan or missing transcript cannot be replayed safely.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • Supported recovery restores evidence or new work begins with a deliberate current-state inspection.

What not to do

  • Do not delete evidence or invent a configuration change for an unexplained internal failure.

Technical notes

  • State diagnostics preserve authoritative journal, ownership and effect evidence. They do not delete records, loosen ownership fences, issue SQL or restart/replay work; missing persistence confirmation is separate from in-memory acceptance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
